## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request is focused on one concern.
- [ ] Formatting (`cargo fmt --check`), clippy (`cargo clippy --release --all-targets -- -D warnings`), and tests (`cargo test`) pass.
- [ ] Kept code completely clean and free of comments.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or private keys committed.
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior or flags changed.
